title: A Study Of Clinical Implications Of Pulmonary Vascular Disease In Valvular Heart Disease
official: Clinical Implications of Pulmonary Vascular Disease in Valvular Heart Disease
summary: The purpose of this study is to characterize pulmonary hemodynamic profiles, with a focus on PVR subtypes, in patients with left-sided valvular heart disease undergoing aortic or mitral valve intervention, and to identify patterns predicting reversibility of TR and RV dysfunction.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥18 years old; AND
* Scheduled for valve procedures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Congenital heart disease (except for bicuspid aortic valve), OR
* Carcinoid heart disease, OR
* Valvular mass, OR
* Endocarditis, OR
* Any other condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would impair their ability to complete the study
